name: Review Desk
tagline: Drafts review replies in your shop's own voice, star-sorted, with you approving each one.
description: Aim it at a local shop's Google and Yelp reviews and it sorts them by star rating, then drafts a reply that sounds like that business rather than a form letter - warmth for five-star notes, care and a next step for one-star ones. Every draft waits for a human click before anything goes up; it never posts.
author: AraXsuper
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
